checks.finding: Exactly ONE occurrence of 'cooldowns.kingsbane' (line 1169, the assignment in the constructor) and ZERO occurrences of 'cooldowns.kingsbane->'. The member declaration at line 475 reads 'cooldown_t* kingsbane;' inside the cooldowns_t struct and so does not contain the qualified name. Every mutation — adjust(), reset(), duration assignment, charge change — would have to go through the arrow form, and none exists.
_charges is 0, so there is no charge system and no recharge behaviour to model.
